name: Human first-trimester decidua, invaded (Visium)
description: Visium section of human first-trimester decidua basalis invaded by extravillous trophoblasts, over its H&E: 871 spots with whole-transcriptome expression (36,601 genes) read from GEO's Matrix Market files; opens on HLA-G (extravillous trophoblasts), from a study of how trophoblast invasion remodels the decidua.

source.citation: Moser G et al. (2026) Remodeling lesions locate at sites of strong extravillous trophoblast invasion and are associated with neutrophil presence in the human first-trimester decidua. Human Reproduction. doi:10.1093/humrep/deag078
